profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Honeywell Aerospace - Lead for DO-178C and DO-178B Certified Engine Propulsion Systems
profile.summary:
Innovative Senior Systems Software Engineering Professional with a wide range of skills and technical knowledge covering all phases of product development. Extensive experience communicating with customers and executive-level leadership, presenting technical information to non-technical audiences and negotiating contracts with external resources.  Recognized for consistent project management success in challenging, complex environments, while meeting business goals.

Key technical and business strengths include:

✔	Project Management
✔	Customer Service 
✔	Executing Research and Design Projects	
✔	Earned Value Management
✔	Bid and Proposal Writing
✔	Identifying and Capturing Customer Requirements
✔	Risk Assessment / Risk Abatement Management 
✔	Architecting, Designing and Executing Real-Time Embedded Systems
✔	Lead for DO-178C and DO-178B Certified Engine Propulsion Systems

Please contact me at:  LisaFJames@gmail.com

TECHNICAL SKILLS:

Tools:
MS Project / PowerPoint / Excel / Word / Visio, DOORS, ClearCase, CM Synergy, SourceSafe, Perforce

Languages:
C++/C, Ada, Rational Rose RT, FORTRAN, Perl, Java, PL/SQLPLUS

Operating Systems:
VxWorks, UNIX, AIX, POSIX, MCOS, Linux, SunOS, RMS68K

Machines:
Sun, IBM, PC and Clones, Mercury Computers, HP, VAX, Silicon Graphics

Protocols:
TCP/IP, UDP, RS-232, SNMP, TL1, ZModem, Kermit, HLA++

CLEARANCE STATUS:

Inactive Top Secret Clearance Issued April, 2008.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Provide technical management and process leadership to the Electronic Power and Controllers Center of Excellence DO-178B software development teams. 
•	Support technical proposals, project estimates, IPDS process deployment, project planning, project tracking, earned value management, technical guidance to team members, and supplier management of global and outsource suppliers.
•	Implemented several process improvements to the project reporting and project scheduling standards.

positions.title: Principal System Engineer
positions.description:
SM-3 Block IIA System Architect	2012 – 2013
Completed final design and documentation for BIT, Missile Logistics and Missile Reprogramming architectures for System CDR in October 2013.  
•	Met aggressive schedule for project CDR’s by collaborating with System Test team in completing Embedded BIT Architecture Design Documentation.

Sparrow Targets L-1011 Program Manager	2012
Oversaw successful completion of FIT test of Blue and Black Sparrow Targets on Orbital L-1011 at Orbital Flight Facility in Mojave, CA after a 2-year delay.  This included: 1. Coordinating flight team and maintenance crew schedules and 2. Working with supply chain and finance departments to manage subcontractor contracts.

ESSM Principal System Engineer 	2011 – 2012
Recruited to assist ESSM JUWL System team in completion of specifications for System CDR.
•	Ensured that System team would meet aggressive CDR milestone by completing 3 of 4 critical system specifications.  

Digital Semi-Active Laser (dSAL) Program Manager 	2011
Designed, developed and built dSAL sensors for multiple missile programs.
•	Completed critical delivery of (12) dSAL units to support LGR Phase 3 testing.

CIRCM Proposal System Architect / Deputy Program Manager	2010 – 2011
Oversaw “Price-to-Win” strategy meetings, implementation of schedule, BOM and BOEs, generation of Subcontractor Statement of Works (SOW), trade studies, and risk management activities. 

KillerBee Unmanned Air System (UAS) IR&D Software IPT Lead 	2009 – 2010
Performed weekly and monthly EVMS duties along with risk management and status reports.

Griffin Program Manager	2007 – 2009
Performed Project Management oversight for several of the Griffin programs 
•	Reduced factory test equipment budget and delivery schedule 50% by outsourcing work to subcontractor resulting in cost savings of $2M and schedule savings of 9 months.
•	Won as a team the Raytheon Missile System’s 2007 Excellence Award for timely and innovative design of Griffin missile.

positions.title: Senior System Software Engineer
positions.description:
Managed all aspects of new software for Line Test System Controller (LTSC) application.  LTSC is large scale C++/C and Oracle 9i application that runs on Linux, Solaris, and AIX platforms. 
  
•	Provided Sales Engineer support to create BOMs, SOWs and proposals.
